description: Election Commission - Y. I. Thamara Kumari was selected as the Member of the Weligepola Praseshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Weligepola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This fits the definition of Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) for electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authority elections.
